payload.text: For hv on return (19 Oct): 0072's chain needs hv's words in gtools-ic's session, in order: (1) hv's look at arca_swift's example console (AC-09.6) after a green run E; (2) the landing on arca_swift's main; (3) the push to GitHub, whose push run on main is 0.2.0's dependency proof on Xcode 26.6; (4) the 0.2.0 tag.
